summary: All 6 acceptance criteria validated. Quality gates pass: lint (0 warnings), typecheck (0 errors), tests (674/674 pass across 74 files, +24 new tests). Code review of all 6 changed files confirms correctness and architecture preservation. One minor deviation noted in AC-5 (timeout timers don't reset on ready/unready toggle) but the intent is met (nudge display is gated on !localReady, and 120s total lobby timeout is a reasonable safeguard).

AC-5.note: Minor deviation: timers run from bothPresentSinceRef.current and do not explicitly reset on ready/unready toggle. Nudge text display is gated on !localReady (line 899), so it is hidden when ready. The 120s auto-forfeit serves as a total lobby timeout regardless of ready state — an acceptable design for preventing indefinite lobby stalls.

feedback.message: Unready timeout (AC-5) timers do not reset on ready/unready toggle. The auto-forfeit timer continues from bothPresentSinceRef regardless of ready state. This is acceptable as a total lobby timeout but slightly deviates from 'timers reset on ready/unready' in the AC description. The nudge text is correctly suppressed when localReady is true.
feedback.action: Consider adding localReady/opponentReady to the timeout effect deps to reset timers on toggle, or document the 120s as a hard lobby timeout.

feedback.message: handleLeave captured in the forfeit timeout closure may have a stale 'finished' value. If the game finishes between timer setup and timer fire, a forfeit event could be sent for a completed game. The server would reject this, so impact is low.
feedback.action: No action required — server-side is the backstop.

learnings.insight: The unready timeout effect (DuelRoom.tsx:601-617) does not reset timers on ready/unready toggle. Timers run from bothPresentSinceRef.current. The nudge text is gated on !localReady so it's hidden when ready. The 120s auto-forfeit serves as a total lobby timeout.
learnings.action: Verify whether the 120s hard timeout is acceptable when one player is ready and waiting for the other, or if it should reset when either player toggles.

learnings.insight: Ghost store tests parametric on GHOST_RENDER_DELAY_TICKS (D) adapt automatically to constant changes. 24 new tests added in duelLobby.test.ts cover AC-1 through AC-6 where testable without browser DOM.
learnings.action: New lobby/countdown logic is in React components (DuelRoom.tsx, paintClimbFrame.ts) which need DOM/canvas for full integration testing. Unit tests cover the pure-function aspects.

learnings.insight: countdownNum fallback (line 652-654) uses sim ticks when wall-clock path is not active (countdownStartsAt === 0). This only triggers on the slot-1 fallback path where no 'start' event was received.
learnings.action: Monitor whether the slot-1 fallback path activates in production — if it does, the countdown will not be wall-clock synced.
